ready1_open_rewrite.title: CMM-Math open-ended question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: In the plane rectangular coordinate system $xOy$, $M$ is a moving point on the region represented by the system of inequalities $\left\{\begin{array}{l}2x-y-2\geq0,\\x+2y-1\geq0,\\3x+y-8\leq0\end{array}\right.$. Find the minimum value of the slope of the line $OM$.
